race.comment: LOUD (10) raced on speed and was too slick fresh after a very long spell so can only be fitter. This is the third start straight he's drawn the inside and with good speed will take catching again. POISED (11) caught the eye last start over 1200m at Gilgandra, coming from the tail and running on strongly to score by 0.6 lengths. Has been in solid form this campaign with a win and two minor placings from six starts. Has upside and bold showing expected. INJAIR (7) turned in a strong performance first-up when in the money at Wean but disappointed last time at Moree over 1300m. This easier and can return to form. DEODEE (5) missed the placings two runs back then didn't do any better last start when 6 lengths away in tenth over 1300m at Bathurst. This easier and watch for sharp improvement. HIT SONG (3) has good claims on best figures.
